article.title: Deposit by defendant of amount in satisfaction of claim.
article.content: The defendant in any suit to recover a debt or damages may, at any stage of the suit, deposit in Court such sum of money as he considers a satisfaction in full of the claim.
article.html:
1Deposit by defendant of amount in satisfaction of claim.

Order 24, Rule 1

The defendant in any suit to recover a debt or damages may, at any stage of the suit, deposit in Court such sum of money as he considers a satisfaction in full of the claim.
